environment.concurrentWorkload: Regression tests during part of development split; CUDA transcription and PyInstaller build during the final evaluation tracks

datasets.selection: Odd-indexed file names within each genre; 50 tracks

comparison.trackedBeats: One Beat This! inference per track, reused by all beat-grid fitting methods
comparison.legacy: Librosa estimator from baselineCommit, rerun in the current environment
comparison.previousApplication: EarCopy Assist 0.1.5 robust fit with MuScriptor 0.3.0 meter inference, applied to the same tracked beats
comparison.muscriptor040: Official 0.4.0 regularized_beats, fit_tempo and meter inference; use the average BPM for non-steady recordings
comparison.librosaOnUnsteady: Official 0.4.0 when steady; otherwise the legacy Librosa estimator
comparison.selection: Official 0.4.0 selected using development split BPM accuracy and downbeat macro F1; evaluation split used afterwards
comparison.timing: Shared inference time plus each estimator calculation; not an independent end-to-end latency comparison
